name: Alte Schmiede
notes: /programm sidebar list gives all upcoming Literaturwerkstatt readings in one fetch (no pagination needed); each detail page at /programm/recital/<slug> has a date-test="YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" attribute for exact start. Site currently only publishes ~2.5 months ahead (through end of Oct 2026), well inside the 180d horizon. No price info anywhere on site -> price_min/price_text always null. category = h3.event-hashtag (series name, e.g. "124. AUTOR*INNENPROJEKT"), empty for ~46% of events -> null. Single fixed venue (Schönlaterngasse 9, 1010 Wien) hardcoded. Musikwerkstatt (music) events live under a different section and are intentionally not scraped since covers=readings.
